text.arabic_uthmani: وَلَوْ كَانُوا۟ يُؤْمِنُونَ بِٱللَّهِ وَٱلنَّبِىِّ وَمَآ أُنزِلَ إِلَيْهِ مَا ٱتَّخَذُوهُمْ أَوْلِيَآءَ وَلَٰكِنَّ كَثِيرًۭا مِّنْهُمْ فَٰسِقُونَ

words.gloss_range: opening conjunction linking the ayah to the prior indictment
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) opens the ayah as continuation, so the counterfactual does not float as a detached maxim. It carries 5:80's visible alliance behavior into a diagnostic explanation of why that behavior occurred.

topics.headline: linked opening to prior indictment
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah begins as the explanation of 5:80, not as an isolated conditional sentence.
topics.reason: The opening conjunction is licensed as coordination/continuation, and the following counterfactual clause supplies the diagnostic argument.

words.gloss_range: counterfactual particle marking an unrealized condition
words.prose: {{ar:لَوْ}} ({{tr:law}}) makes the belief condition counterfactual rather than open-ended. It starts a three-panel movement: unreal belief, negated alliance-taking, and then the factual diagnosis.

topics.headline: unreal condition as diagnosis
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the verse is reasoning from a known failure of belief, not merely proposing a possible scenario.
topics.reason: The particle opens the syntactically forced protasis and is followed by a negated apodosis, matching the CRITICAL counterfactual rows.

words.gloss_range: perfect auxiliary hosting the denied continuous belief-state
words.root_gloss_range: being, becoming, and occurring, locally narrowed to auxiliary state under a counterfactual condition
words.prose: {{ar:كَانُوا۟}} ({{tr:kānū}}) places the subject in a denied state of being under {{ar:لَوْ}} ({{tr:law}}). The plural ending keeps the same group from 5:80 in view, while the auxiliary gives the following belief verb a past-continuous diagnostic frame.

topics.headline: past state under unreal condition
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the problem is an absent standing condition, not one missed moment of belief.
topics.reason: The perfect auxiliary is inside the scope of the counterfactual and governs the following imperfect as its predicate.

topics.headline: plural subject carried in the verb
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the same diagnosed group is carried forward without being renamed.
topics.reason: The finite plural morphology supplies the subject while boundary evidence links it to the group already under discussion.

topics.headline: state verb set against alliance action
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a pattern in which a missing state of belief is set against a later completed act of alliance-taking.
topics.reason: The co-occurrence and structural rows are coherent with the local order from auxiliary state to completed taking verb.

words.gloss_range: imperfect Form IV belief verb as the content of the denied condition
words.root_gloss_range: security, trust, and belief, locally selected as directed belief/trust rather than simple safety
words.prose: {{ar:يُؤْمِنُونَ}} ({{tr:yuʾminūna}}) supplies the substance of the counterfactual: an ongoing act of believing and entrusting, governed by {{ar:كَانُوا۟}} ({{tr:kānū}}) and directed into the following object chain. Its root background of trust and security sharpens the contrast with seeking protection through {{ar:أَوْلِيَآءَ}} ({{tr:awliyāʾa}}). Within Surah 5, the word extends the heart-belief failure of 5:41 into the concrete behavior of alliance-taking.

topics.headline: ongoing belief rather than static label
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the condition tests an operating disposition of belief, not a one-time claim or fixed label.
topics.reason: The imperfect verb functions as the predicate of the auxiliary, and the rows consistently distinguish this verbal process from a participial label.

topics.headline: belief takes a governed object chain
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that belief is directed toward God, the Prophet, and what was sent down, not left as an abstract attitude.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence forces the bāʾ-governed complement and coordinated belief objects.

topics.headline: trust and security pressure within Form IV belief
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that failed belief also reads as failed entrusting and false security-seeking, while the local form remains a belief verb.
topics.reason: The root family supports trust and security pressure, but Form IV and local complements keep directed belief as the selected sense.

topics.headline: same-surah belief failure applied to alliance
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that 5:81 extends earlier Surah 5 belief-failure language into the concrete behavior of alliance-taking.
topics.reason: The cited same-surah rows give concrete anchors such as 5:41 and are consistent with the local counterfactual.

words.gloss_range: bāʾ-marked divine name as first object of belief
words.root_gloss_range: worship and awe around the divine name, locally functioning as the definite first belief-object
words.prose: {{ar:بِٱللَّهِ}} ({{tr:bi-llāhi}}) makes the first object of belief explicit and definite. The attached bāʾ directs belief toward God, while the following coordinated objects remain under the same governance so the triad begins with source before channel and content.

topics.headline: bāʾ-governed belief object
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that belief is grammatically attached to its object, not left vague.
topics.reason: The prefixed bāʾ is the syntactically forced complement marker of the belief verb.

topics.headline: one clitic organizes the belief triad
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that God, the Prophet, and revelation form one governed chain rather than three detached claims.
topics.reason: The later coordinated objects share the belief-governance initiated here.

topics.headline: definite divine source and awe-pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the triad begins with the definite divine source whose authority rules the rest of the condition.
topics.reason: The proper name and derivational evidence support authority and awe pressure, while the local syntax keeps it as the first governed belief object.

topics.headline: belief in God set against false alliance
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that 5:81 turns the alliance prohibitions of 5:51 and 5:57 into a diagnosis of missing belief.
topics.reason: The cited same-surah root-pair rows are concrete and match the local contrast between belief and alliance-taking.

words.gloss_range: coordinating conjunction adding the Prophet as second belief object
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) joins the Prophet to the first belief object under the same verbal governance. It preserves distinction between source and channel while keeping both inside one counterfactual condition.

topics.headline: first internal link of the belief triad
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the Prophet is not introduced as a separate topic but as the second object within the same belief test.
topics.reason: Coordination and genitive sharing attach the second object to the prior governed complement.

words.gloss_range: definite genitive prophetic title as mediating belief object
words.root_gloss_range: news-bearing and elevated-station pressures, locally narrowed to the known prophetic channel
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلنَّبِىِّ}} ({{tr:al-nabiyyi}}) stands between God and the sent-down content, making the Prophet the mediating channel in the belief triad. The title also prepares the singular pronoun in {{ar:إِلَيْهِ}} ({{tr:ilayhi}}), so revelation is sent down to him, not to the plural group.

topics.headline: middle term between source and content
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the Prophet mediates source and revelation content inside one belief condition.
topics.reason: The noun is coordinated as the second belief object and becomes the nearest antecedent for the recipient pronoun.

topics.headline: known singular title in governed slot
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the condition concerns the known prophetic channel, not prophecy as an abstract class.
topics.reason: Definiteness, genitive case, and singular form all support the local title reading.

topics.headline: news-bearing and elevated-office pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the title carries news-bearing and elevated-office pressure, while the local role remains the Prophet as object of belief.
topics.reason: The derivational dispute is valid background pressure, but it does not replace the local title function.

topics.headline: prophetic title in Surah 5 revelation settings
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that 5:81 belongs to Surah 5 scenes where prophetic authority and sent-down revelation are linked.
topics.reason: The concrete anchor at 5:44 supports the local source-channel-content relation.

words.gloss_range: coordinating conjunction completing the belief-object chain
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) introduces the final member of the triad, the revealed content. It both adds and completes the chain, keeping what was sent down under the same counterfactual belief test.

topics.headline: final coordination into revelation content
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the revelation clause is the third coordinated object of belief, not an explanatory aside.
topics.reason: The conjunction links the relative clause to the same belief-governed chain.

words.gloss_range: relative pronoun opening the revealed-content object
words.prose: {{ar:مَآ}} ({{tr:mā}}) is relative, not negative: it opens the content defined by the descent clause. Its surface resemblance to the later {{ar:مَا}} ({{tr:mā}}) creates a local pivot from what should be believed to what would not have occurred.

topics.headline: relative pronoun forming the third object
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that a whole descent clause is compacted into the third object of belief.
topics.reason: The relative clause is syntactically forced and functions inside the belief-object chain.

topics.headline: same surface later reparsed as negation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the sharp shift from relative construction to negation when the same-looking particle returns at word 12.
topics.reason: The two particles have different syntactic slots, and the rows preserve that contrast.

words.gloss_range: Form IV passive perfect of revelation descent inside the relative clause
words.root_gloss_range: descent, lodging, provision, and revelation; locally narrowed to caused passive descent of revealed content
words.prose: {{ar:أُنزِلَ}} ({{tr:unzila}}) completes the relative object by naming the content as something already caused to descend. The passive keeps the sender grammatically unexpressed while the prior divine source remains clear, and the root image lets revelation feel like delivered descent rather than abstract information.

topics.headline: passive descent completes the belief object
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the third object of belief is completed, already-given revealed content.
topics.reason: The passive perfect supplies the predicate of the relative clause and is constrained by the endpoint phrase.

topics.headline: passive foregrounds content and recipient
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the wording foregrounds the received revelation without needing to restate the divine sender.
topics.reason: Passive morphology suppresses the agent, while the previous belief object names God as source.

topics.headline: physical descent and provision pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a delivered-descent image around revelation, while the local sense remains revealed content sent down.
topics.reason: The root family supports descent/provision imagery, but local passive revelation grammar selects scripture-like content.

topics.headline: Surah 5 sent-down revelation thread
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that 5:81 joins Surah 5 passages where sent-down revelation becomes the test of response.
topics.reason: The concrete 5:59 and same-surah rows cohere with the local belief-object clause.

words.gloss_range: preposition plus singular pronoun marking the endpoint of descent
words.prose: {{ar:إِلَيْهِ}} ({{tr:ilayhi}}) closes the descent mini-arc by naming its endpoint: toward him, the Prophet just mentioned. The singular suffix prevents the revealed content from being redirected to the plural group under diagnosis.

topics.headline: singular endpoint of revelation descent
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the relative clause resolves into a singular prophetic recipient, not a vague or plural destination.
topics.reason: The preposition marks the endpoint and the suffix refers most naturally to the nearest singular antecedent.

topics.headline: prepositional tail completes the object clause
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices how one bound phrase completes the source-to-recipient movement inside the belief object.
topics.reason: The relative clause requires the endpoint phrase to finish the recipient relation.

words.gloss_range: negative particle opening the counterfactual apodosis
words.prose: {{ar:مَا}} ({{tr:mā}}) changes the ayah from belief condition to denied consequence. Unlike the earlier relative {{ar:مَآ}} ({{tr:mā}}), this particle negates the completed act of taking allies and forms the second panel of the verse.

topics.headline: negation of the counterfactual result
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that genuine belief would have blocked the alliance-making act itself.
topics.reason: The particle introduces the syntactically forced answer to the counterfactual protasis.

topics.headline: repeated surface becomes negation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the local turn from defining revealed content to denying alliance action through a repeated particle sound.
topics.reason: The first particle is relative and constructive; this one is negative and blocks the apodosis action.

words.gloss_range: Form VIII perfect with plural subject and object suffix in a double-object construction
words.root_gloss_range: taking, seizing, adopting, and being held accountable; locally narrowed to deliberate adoption into a role
words.prose: {{ar:ٱتَّخَذُوهُمْ}} ({{tr:ittakhadhūhum}}) is not bare seizing; in Form VIII with {{ar:أَوْلِيَآءَ}} ({{tr:awliyāʾa}}) it means adopting them as allies. Its suffix keeps the object group from 5:80 inside the verb, and the perfect form contrasts a completed alliance action with the missing continuous belief state.

topics.headline: made them into allies
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the action assigns a role to the object group: they were taken as allies.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence forces the suffix as first object and the following noun as second object.

topics.headline: subject and object groups carried in the verb
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the verb imports both the diagnosing group and the taken group without renaming either.
topics.reason: The plural subject agreement and object suffix preserve the cross-ayah referent chain.

topics.headline: Form VIII self-directed adoption
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the taking is deliberate adoption for themselves, while the local construction narrows the root to alliance-role assignment.
topics.reason: Root and form evidence support adoption/seizure pressure, but the second object selects the alliance-making sense.

topics.headline: prohibited formula recast as counterfactual diagnosis
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that 5:81 turns the prohibitions of 5:51 and 5:57 into a statement of what true belief would have prevented.
topics.reason: The same root-pair appears in the cited prohibitive formulae, while the local mood is diagnostic counterfactual rather than command.

words.gloss_range: indefinite accusative plural naming the role assigned by the taking verb
words.root_gloss_range: nearness, following, protection, patronage, and authority; locally narrowed to allies/protective patrons in the double-object frame
words.prose: {{ar:أَوْلِيَآءَ}} ({{tr:awliyāʾa}}) gives the result of the taking: the object group is made into allies, protectors, or patrons. Its indefinite plural form marks a role rather than a fixed title, and the root range makes the role heavier than ordinary friendship.

topics.headline: resulting role in double-object frame
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the clause lands on the role produced by the taking, not merely on the act of taking.
topics.reason: The noun is the accusative second object of the taking verb and closes the apodosis.

topics.headline: role-like plural rather than fixed title
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the wording says as allies in an open role, not as an already named class.
topics.reason: Indefiniteness and broken plural form support role assignment and plurality.

topics.headline: nearness and authority behind alliance
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that alliance here carries nearness, protection, patronage, and authority pressure, while the local slot keeps the translation in the allies/protectors range.
topics.reason: The root range is broad, but the double-object construction selects a social-political alliance role.

topics.headline: false alliance against proper loyalty field
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that 5:81 sits against the Surah 5 contrast between prohibited allies (5:51) and the proper waliyy field (5:55).
topics.reason: The concrete same-surah references support the local false-alliance diagnosis.

words.gloss_range: connective that fuses with the adversative particle for the final turn
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) begins the final turn, keeping the argument continuous while preparing correction. Heard with {{ar:لَٰكِنَّ}} ({{tr:lākinna}}), it moves from what belief would have prevented to what is actually true of many of them.

topics.headline: continuity plus adversative turn
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the final diagnosis continues the argument while reversing the expected outcome.
topics.reason: The conjunction is part of the adversative clause that contrasts with the counterfactual apodosis.

words.gloss_range: heavy adversative particle governing the final diagnostic clause
words.prose: {{ar:لَٰكِنَّ}} ({{tr:lākinna}}) opens the factual counterstatement and governs the final clause. It does more than say but: it replaces the unreal prevention with an emphatic diagnosis that many of them are boundary-breakers.

topics.headline: final factual counterstatement
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah does not stop at the prevented action; it names the real state explaining it.
topics.reason: The particle introduces the syntactically forced contrast clause after the counterfactual apodosis.

topics.headline: governed subject and predicate
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the diagnosis is grammatically weighted as a governed declarative clause.
topics.reason: The particle governs the accusative subject and leaves the predicate nominative.

topics.headline: heavy corrective adversation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the firm corrective force of the turn from hypothetical reasoning to factual verdict.
topics.reason: Semantic and form rows support stronger correction than a light contrast alone.

words.gloss_range: indefinite substantive quantity governed as the subject of the adversative clause
words.root_gloss_range: abundance and numerousness, locally non-total and partitive
words.prose: {{ar:كَثِيرًۭا}} ({{tr:kathīran}}) functions substantively as many, not as a modifier of an expressed noun. Its accusative form is governed by {{ar:لَٰكِنَّ}} ({{tr:lākinna}}), and its indefiniteness gives the verdict serious scale without making it total. The same many-from-them phrase shifts from what is seen in 5:80 to what is diagnosed in 5:81.

topics.headline: quantity as governed subject
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that many itself becomes the subject of the final diagnosis.
topics.reason: The adjective functions substantively and is governed as the accusative ism of the adversative particle.

topics.headline: large scale without totalizing
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the verdict is broad and grave, yet the wording preserves a non-total remnant.
topics.reason: Indefiniteness, quantity semantics, and the following partitive phrase prevent universalizing the group.

topics.headline: 5:80 phrase repeated as diagnosis
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the same many-from-them phrase shifts from what is seen in 5:80 to what is diagnosed in 5:81.
topics.reason: The concrete boundary repetition is explicit and locally relevant.

topics.headline: quantity carries adversative force toward predicate
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the quantity word bridges the adversative particle into the final moral predicate.
topics.reason: Local clause order and co-occurrence rows support the quantity-to-verdict movement.

words.gloss_range: partitive preposition plus plural pronoun identifying the larger group
words.prose: {{ar:مِّنْهُمْ}} ({{tr:minhum}}) partitions the group before the verdict lands. It says many from among them, keeping the diagnosis internal to the group from 5:80 and the earlier plural verbs while preventing the predicate from covering every member without distinction.

topics.headline: many from among them, not all
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the final verdict selects a broad subset rather than totalizing the whole group.
topics.reason: The preposition is partitive and attaches to the quantified subject.

topics.headline: subset formed before predicate falls
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the clause first forms the subset, then predicates boundary-breaking of that subset.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence links the phrase to the quantity word rather than directly to the predicate.

topics.headline: plural suffix keeps the prior group in view
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the suffix keeps the already discussed group alive, while the exact referent is bounded by the local and 5:80 context.
topics.reason: The suffix points to the discourse group, but the row listing possible referents should be kept as referential range rather than a single asserted expansion.

words.gloss_range: active participle plural closing the ayah with an ongoing moral diagnosis
words.root_gloss_range: exiting a boundary, transgression, and disobedience; locally selected as ongoing boundary-breaking identity
words.prose: {{ar:فَٰسِقُونَ}} ({{tr:fāsiqūna}}) is the final verdict, an active participle rather than a past-tense event. It names many of them as ongoing boundary-breakers, so the alliance action is explained as the symptom of a durable state; the root image of exiting a containing boundary makes the closing classification vivid. The closing label answers the missing belief condition and joins Surah 5's revelation-verdict thread at 5:47 and 5:49.

topics.headline: ongoing state rather than one event
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah closes on a standing identity, not a report that they transgressed once.
topics.reason: The active participle is the nominative predicate of the final clause and encodes ongoing state.

topics.headline: plural predicate locked to the subset
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the final word locks the diagnosis to the quantified human subset and lands the ayah on that verdict.
topics.reason: Agreement and predication evidence tie the predicate to the partitive subject.

topics.headline: date-skin exit image behind transgression
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the moral verdict carries an inside-outside image of leaving a containing boundary, while the local sense remains disobedient boundary-breaking.
topics.reason: The root-image rows are coherent, but they color the selected moral predicate rather than replacing it with a literal physical image.

topics.headline: fisq answers missing belief and revelation response
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the closing label answers the opening missing belief and the failure toward what was sent down.
topics.reason: Rows citing 5:47, 5:49, and the local belief verb support the polarity from absent belief to final verdict.

topics.headline: Surah 5 verdict chain and 5:80 handoff
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that 5:81 turns the witnessed scene of 5:80 into a categorical Surah 5 verdict.
topics.reason: The boundary and same-surah rows are concrete and cohere with the final-word position.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The counterfactual links يُؤْمِنُونَ بالله والنبي وما أنزل إليه directly to ما اتخذوهم أولياء.
baseline_models.mechanism: Faith is heart-settling assent to God, the divine reporter, and delivered revelation; deliberately acquiring a relation of alliance and support is therefore treated as evidence against that settled configuration.

activation_trace.role: Heart-settling assent supplies the inner condition tested by the social relation.
The one reporting from God gives faith a mediated, message-bearing object.
Caused descent and delivery make revelation something received rather than self-produced.
Acquisition for oneself makes the relation a chosen installation rather than an accidental contact.
Love, support, and alliance specify the installed relation whose compatibility with faith is denied.

changed_reading.before: Belief and taking allies were two assertions placed beside one another.
changed_reading.after: The counterfactual makes chosen alliance a diagnostic enactment: settled assent to God, the prophet, and delivered revelation would reorganize whom one installs as supporter.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The paired forms اتخذوهم and أولياء combine acquisition with uninterrupted nearness and charge.
baseline_models.mechanism: The objects are not merely liked; they are made one's own as proximate parties who can support or stand over an affair. The focus tests an allocated social office or allegiance.

activation_trace.role: Making or acquiring something for oneself supplies deliberate allocation.
Nearness without an intervening gap supplies the relation's spatial and social immediacy.
Standing over and administering an affair supplies the possible governance dimension.

changed_reading.before: أولياء was a broad label for friends.
changed_reading.after: أولياء can denote deliberately installed proximity, support, or charge, making the criticized act more structured than ordinary friendliness.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The turn from لو كانوا يؤمنون to ولكن كثيرا منهم فاسقون contrasts settled security with many exiting a containing boundary.
baseline_models.mechanism: Faith offers a settled interior, while فسق contributes the material image of ripe fruit leaving its skin. كثرة scales that breach from an isolated lapse to a prevalent group condition.

activation_trace.role: Security and heart-settling trust supply the stable interior from which the contrast begins.
Numerical growth turns the breach into a prevalent pattern among them.
A ripe fruit exiting its skin supplies the concrete image of crossing out of a containing norm.

changed_reading.before: فاسقون was only a settled moral classification.
changed_reading.after: It also pictures a widespread boundary event: people leave the containing integrity that settled trust would have maintained.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier repeated taking/awliya construction identifies the relevant actors by what they do to دين: obedience is converted into mockery and purposeless play. This narrows the installed relation from generic contact to empowered proximity with agents who trivialize the community's governing commitment.

activation_trace.role: Deliberate acquisition anchors the changed reading in the focus act.
Standing over an affair supplies the empowered proximity being allocated.
Obedience and submission identify what the targeted conduct treats as an object.
Mockery supplies the first mode by which that obedience is publicly devalued.
Action without a sound purpose supplies the second mode of trivialization.

structural_cues: 5:57 repeats لا تتخذوا ... أولياء, while 5:59 repeats faith, descent, كثرة, and فسق before the focus restates the cluster.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the repeated construction and the obedience/mockery/play images; I infer that trivialization explains why the installed relation contradicts faith, while a live alternative is that these are adjacent qualifications rather than a causal rationale.

changed_reading.before: The focus could be heard as barring any friendship with an undifferentiated group.
changed_reading.after: It diagnoses acquiring empowered proximity with actors characterized here by turning obedience into mockery and purposeless play; ordinary contact is not the operative mechanism.

context_deltas.mechanism: The shell-exit image of فسق becomes a permeability process: a verbal profession accompanies entry with concealed disbelief and exit with it, then appears publicly as haste toward conduct that strips value away, without effective restraint by learned authorities.

activation_trace.role: Exit from a skin anchors the focus label as a breached boundary rather than a static tag.
Literal entry supplies the inbound phase of the boundary sequence.
Passing outward supplies the matching outbound phase without inner change.
Concealment explains how the incompatible interior can traverse the professed boundary.
Speed against slowness turns the breach into an observable behavioral acceleration.
Stripping and eradication give the public conduct a materially consuming effect.
Restraint from action supplies the missing institutional check on the breach.

structural_cues: 5:61 moves through profession, entry, concealment, and exit; 5:62 makes the resulting conduct visible; 5:63 asks why authorities do not restrain it.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies movement, concealment, haste, stripping, and absent restraint; I infer a temporal path from concealed profession to public practice and institutional failure, while these may instead be parallel symptoms with no strict causal order.

changed_reading.before: Many being فاسقون named a private or doctrinal defect.
changed_reading.after: Their فسق is legible as a repeated breach system: an unchanged concealed interior crosses a verbal boundary, accelerates into damaging practice, and persists because restraint fails.

context_deltas.mechanism: Descent does not automatically equal believing reception. The context sets two trajectories around the same revelation: establish it and transmit it to its destination, or have its arrival increase limit-breaking. The focus condition يؤمنون ... بما أنزل names the successful reception, not bare exposure.

activation_trace.role: Settled assent anchors the receptive outcome required by the focus counterfactual.
Delivered descent supplies the message whose reception can follow different trajectories.
Shell-exit anchors the failed trajectory as movement beyond a containing limit.
The same delivered revelation reappears as the input that does not guarantee assent.
Growth supplies the directional change by which reception intensifies an existing disposition.
Exceeding the limit in disobedience names the first mapped image of failed reception.
The second mapped inventory independently preserves limit-exceeding as the failed trajectory.
Straightening and establishing supply the enacted alternative to merely encountering revelation.
Carrying the message through to its destination supplies the transmission stage of successful delivery.

structural_cues: 5:65-66 repeat the لو counterfactual and attach faith and establishing revelation to changed outcomes.
5:64 and 5:68 repeat revelation increasing many in transgression and covering, with 5:67 placing complete transmission between them.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies descent, establishment, transmission, increase, and limit-exceeding; I infer a reception fork in which enacted establishment mediates between delivery and faith, while an alternative is that revelation only exposes an already fixed disposition rather than changing it.

changed_reading.before: Believing in what descended meant acknowledging that revealed content exists.
changed_reading.after: It means completing a reception trajectory in which delivered revelation is settled, established, and allowed to govern; the same arrival can instead disclose or intensify movement beyond its limits.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context places two binding acts in tension: a covenant is taken, yet desire becomes the followed sequence, obedience is exited, and mutual restraint disappears. Taking awliya can therefore function as installing a rival chain of custody and following in place of the covenant-message chain.

activation_trace.role: Acquiring for oneself anchors the focus as a choice of binding arrangement.
Unbroken succession supplies the chain-like structure of the chosen allegiance.
Taking and holding supplies the mirrored act by which the covenant is made binding.
The confirmed covenant supplies the prior binding relation against which later allegiance is measured.
The soul's inclination supplies the pressure that rejects messages not matching it.
Allegiance and succession convert inclination into a repeatable following relation.
Repeated inward inclination identifies what the rival sequence follows.
Exit from obedience states the result of replacing the covenant's demand.
Absent reciprocal restraint shows the rival sequence becoming socially self-maintaining.

structural_cues: 5:70 begins with taking a covenant and repeatedly receiving messengers; 5:77-79 end with following desires, disobedience, and failure to restrain one another.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies mirrored taking, a binding covenant, desire-following, exited obedience, and absent restraint; I infer substitution of one governing chain for another, while a live alternative is that alliance is only one downstream symptom of covenant failure rather than its replacement.

changed_reading.before: Taking awliya was an isolated social choice.
changed_reading.after: It can be a rival binding sequence: chosen proximity institutionalizes whom desire follows after the covenant-message sequence has lost practical control.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediately preceding scene repeats many among them and the same w-l-y relation, then calls it what their own selves advanced for them and gives it a clinging outcome. The focus counterfactual becomes an explanation of a self-authored, temporally durable alignment.

activation_trace.role: Alliance and support anchor the focus explanation in the exact relation observed just before it.
Numerical prevalence supplies the immediately repeated group scale.
Active alliance supplies the observed conduct that the focus counterfactual diagnoses.
Advancing forward gives the alliance a prospective, consequence-bearing direction.
The self itself assigns authorship of the advanced act to those making the alignment.
Displeasure opposite approval supplies the evaluative reversal produced by that choice.
Clinging and continued attachment supply the durable endpoint of the trajectory.

structural_cues: 5:80 and 5:81 are adjacent and repeat كثيرا منهم plus the w-l-y relation; observation is followed by a لو counterfactual diagnosis.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies adjacency, lexical repetition, self-advancement, displeasure, and clinging; I infer that 5:81 explains the observed alignment as a durable self-authored trajectory, while it could instead be a moral diagnosis without a developed causal timeline.

changed_reading.before: The criticized relation was a present attitude or association.
changed_reading.after: It is a deliberate act the self sends ahead, installing an alignment whose effects adhere; the absence of settled faith explains that temporal commitment.

context_deltas.mechanism: The following passage uses separate roots to praise closeness and affection, then depicts unarrogant hearing, recognition of descended truth, and professed faith. This differentiates qurb and wudd from the deliberately installed w-l-y relation and makes response to revelation, not a group label alone, decisive.

activation_trace.role: Standing over an affair anchors the criticized relation as more structured than mere emotional nearness.
Settled assent remains the focus criterion by which the contrasting response is read.
Nearness against distance supplies a positively marked relation distinct from w-l-y.
Love and affection supply the positive affect that cannot simply be equated with the focus prohibition.
Absence of self-greatness supplies the posture that permits receptive movement.
Hearing as understanding and compliance supplies reception rather than mere acoustic exposure.
The same delivered descent supplies the object that now reaches a receptive audience.
Recognition through a distinguishing trace supplies the cognitive turn toward truth.
Professed settled assent completes the contrasting reception sequence.

structural_cues: 5:82 moves from hostility to closest affection within named populations; 5:83-84 then narrate hearing, recognition, faith, and hope for entry among the صالحين.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies distinct relation-roots and a positive reception sequence; I infer that their lexical contrast limits awliya to a more governing allegiance than every form of affection, while the alternative is that 5:82 only describes disposition and does not itself define permissible alliance.

changed_reading.before: The focus seemed to condemn closeness or affection according to a fixed communal label.
changed_reading.after: It distinguishes installed allegiance from affection and proximity: members of a named population can approach, love, hear, recognize, and believe, so revelatory response rather than label alone controls the diagnosis.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it promotes the form-distant road branch of نبي and gait branch of أخذ into one mechanism. It remains packet-anchored because the focus also supplies ordered descent and succession, while 5:77 explicitly supplies following, inclination, an even course, and a path. Render it only as route imagery that may illuminate social imitation, not as replacement lexicography or settled exegesis.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: النبي, ما أنزل, اتخذوهم, and أولياء can form a route-and-succession cluster inside 5:81.

activation_trace.role: A clear road leading to a destination turns the prophet anchor into route imagery.
Putting a thing in its proper station supplies ordered placement along that route.
Adopting a people's gait, form, or conduct supplies the imitative mechanism.
One thing following another without interruption supplies the rival succession.
Following behind supplies an explicit contextual enactment of route imitation.
Inward inclination supplies what steers the following sequence.
A middle, just course supplies the route from which the sequence departs.
An extended traversable path makes the contextual route explicit.

changed_reading.before: Taking awliya concerned only choosing patrons.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, it can also picture adopting a rival gait and uninterrupted sequence instead of letting the prophet-road and properly placed revelation set one's course.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This cross-domain model is surprising because it combines the water-holding and following-rain branches of focus words with later tears and rivers. It remains anchored in descent, taking, awliya, and shell-exit, and the context supplies actual overflow and flow. Downstream prose must mark it as a material analogy for reception and transmission, not claim that the focus lexemes literally denote a hydraulic system.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: ما أنزل, اتخذوهم, أولياء, and فاسقون admit a contained material analogy of descent, holding, sequence, and boundary rupture.

activation_trace.role: Descent and settling supply the incoming material in the reception analogy.
A basin that holds water supplies a form-distant image for acquired containment.
Rain following earlier rain supplies sequenced replenishment to the chosen relation.
Fruit breaking out of its skin supplies the failed container boundary.
Easy abundant overflow supplies a contrasting receptive release.
A vessel filling until it spills supplies the threshold between reception and outward response.
Ongoing flow supplies the downstream continuation of receptive overflow.
A river cutting a channel through earth completes the contextual flow image.

changed_reading.before: The conditional contrasted correct belief with a wrong social choice.
changed_reading.after: As a contained material analogy, it contrasts failed holding that ends in boundary rupture with reception that fills, overflows, and continues along an open channel.

strongest_changes: The repeated taking/awliya construction makes the focus a diagnosis of deliberately installed alliance or charge, not generic affection.
Revelation becomes a reception fork: established and transmitted descent can settle as faith, while the same arrival can disclose or increase limit-breaking.
The post-focus contrast distinguishes criticized w-l-y from closeness and affection, and makes actual response to descended truth more decisive than a group label.
summary.what_was_special: The trace was driven by unusually tight recurrences: the exact many-plus-w-l-y scene in 5:80, the counterfactual and revelation fork in 5:64-68, the covenant-versus-desire sequence in 5:70-79, and the positive qurb/wudd reception sequence immediately after the focus.
remaining_uncertainties: The precise antecedent and social scope of the focus pronouns remain underdetermined by branch activation alone.
The w-l-y inventory keeps support, affection, proximity, and governance live; context narrows them but does not force one exclusive English rendering.
The increase caused by revelation may be causal intensification or revelatory exposure of an existing disposition.
The route and hydrological outliers are analogical activations and should not displace the stronger social and reception models.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadeleri bu dali yalniz korkunun kalkmasi olarak degil, kalbin yatismasi, guven verme, guvenilirlik, emanet edilen sey, guvenli yer ve dayanilir nitelik alanlariyla birlikte verir. concept_map.definition: Korkunun kalkmasiyla kalbin yatismasi, birine guven verilmesi veya bir kimsenin ya da seyin guvenilir kabul edilmesidir. Bu alan guvenli yer, emanet edilen sey, kendisine guvenilen kisi ve dayanilir binek gibi bagimli uygulamalari da kapsar.

facets.statement: Temel cekirdek korkuya karsi guven, ic yatiskinligi ve tehlikeden emin olma halidir.
Guven verme, birini kendi koruma ve teminat alani icine alma olarak kullanilir.
Guvenilirlik, ihanete karsi sadakat, emanet edilen sey ve kendisine guvenilen kisi anlamlarini dogurur.
Guvenin bulundugu yer, bir kimsenin emniyet icinde oldugu mesken veya siginak olarak adlandirilir.
Dayanikli ve aksamasindan korkulmayan deve kullanimi, guvenilirlik niteligini canli bir ornege uygular.

facets.statement: Temel cekirdek bir haberin, sozun veya hakikatin dogru sayilmasidir.

Dini alanlarda bu kabul, bildirilen yola girme ve ona baglanma adi olarak kullanilir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi genel olarak herhangi bir şeyi indirmekten çok, Tanrı'nın iyilikleri ve sıkıntıları kullara vermesini, bildiriyi ulaştırmasını, kimi zaman sonucun kendisi yerine nedenlerini göndermesini ve bildirinin bölüm bölüm yinelenmesini anlatır. lexicalization_scope.note: Dal, genel ettirgen biçimlerin yanında Tanrı'nın verme ve bildirme eylemlerine bağlı özel yapıları içerir; özel dinsel kapsam yalın biçimin her kullanımına taşınmaz.

Tanrısal bildiri bölüm bölüm ve tekrar tekrar ulaştırılabilir.
Tanrısal esirgemenin bir topluluğa erişmesi bu ulaştırma biçiminin örneğidir.

Ele geçirilen şeylerin toplanıp bir araya getirilmesi de aynı genel eylem çekirdeğinin kapsamındadır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar, erişip alma ile denetim altına alma ve toplama yönlerini aynı temel eylemin bileşenleri olarak birleştirir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Bir şeyin erişim ve denetim alanına alınmasını, gerektiğinde toplanmasını birlikte anlatan genel karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Erişme, ele geçirme, edinme ve toplama çekirdeğini birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bağlam nesnenin ele geçirilmesini açıkça gösterdiğinde doğal ve kısa bir karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Bir nesneye erişip onu edinme eylemini korur.
error_profile.loses: Denetim altına alma ve bir araya toplama yönlerini açıkça söylemez.

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه آخذته بذنبه ومؤاخذة الإنسان بما صدر منه.
يدخل فيه أخذ الأسير، والأخيذ، ومعنى وخذوهم أي ائسروهم.
يدخل فيه الأخذة رقية تأخذ العين، والتأخيذ والسحر أو الخرزة التي تحبس الرجل أو المرأة عن النكاح أو الرأي.
يدخل فيه الإخاذة بمعنى الضيعة أو الأرض التي يأخذها الإنسان أو السلطان لنفسه ويحوزها ويحييها.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi suyun toplandığı, gölcüğe benzeyen ve kazılarak suyu günlerce tutabilen yeri ortak çekirdek olarak verir. Dalın havuz, çukur ve su birikme yeri bileşenleri bu yapıyı eksiksiz yansıtır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, tanıklanan yalın yer adının su toplama ve tutma işleviyle sınırlıdır; başka söz kalıplarından kapsam alınmaz.

concept_map.definition: Suyun toplandığı ve bir süre tutulduğu, doğal gölcüğe benzeyebilen ya da havuz biçiminde kazılmış yer veya yapıdır.

facets.statement: Suyu bir yerde toplayıp bir süre tutan çukur, havuz veya benzeri yeri anlatır.
Kaynak anlatımlarında yer kimi zaman gölcüğe benzeyen bir birikinti, kimi zaman kişinin kendisi için kazdığı havuz biçimli bir yapı olarak belirir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar suyun toplandığı ve günlerce tutulabildiği yeri ortaklaştırır; anlatım doğal gölcük benzeri yer ile kazılmış havuz biçimi arasında değişir.

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه الإخاذ والإخاذة والإخذ: مجتمع ماء أو حوض أو حفرة تمسك الماء أياما، وما يشبه الغدير.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım topluluğun yolunu ve özelliklerini izleme kalıbıyla sınırlıdır ve yalın köke bağımsız bir izleme anlamı yüklemez.

root_profile.summary: Kökün anlam örgüsü, bağlı bulunulan bir sınırın dışına çıkma tasarımı çevresinde itaat ve buyruktan kopmayı, taze hurmanın kabuğundan çıkışını ve fare için kullanılan küçültmeli kötüleme adını bir araya getirir. Son iki dal, ilk dalın davranışsal anlamını doğrudan paylaşmaz; somut çıkış ve bu çıkışla ya da kötücül sayılmayla açıklanan adlandırma yönünde ayrı uzantılardır.
